content.rationale:
The prerequisite is inline prose that fixes a closed shipped set and a closed exclusion list; the dependent is a manifest, a tool-checkable artifact. Two records in one repository can agree word for word and disagree in effect, so the check has three layers, each answering to one record.

(1) Set fidelity, the prerequisite against the archive: the observable is the set cargo actually packages, read from `cargo package --list` over the crate, and it is compared with the recorded set in both directions. The record names files and it names groups by directory — `every file under `src/``, `every file under `schemas/`` — so a named file absent from the listing is a finding, and every repository file under a named directory that is absent from the listing is a finding, named one by one: shipping a single file out of a named directory is not shipping the group, so the tightening direction is judged as well as the loosening one. A listed path the prose does not name is a finding whichever group it arrives under: the record's exclusion list is exactly the three groups it states, so an exclusion the record does not state buys no path. For a named directory the observation is the crate's own tree under it, taken by walking the repository; the record fixes the group, and the tree and the listing are what that group is held against. Expected membership is transcribed from the prerequisite's recorded inline text and never read from the manifest's file selection, so the expectation cannot be whatever the manifest happens to choose.

(2) Mechanism, the dependent against its own recorded rationale: that record does not commit to an observable alone — it states that it implements the packaged-file-set decision with an explicit cargo `include` allowlist, because an allowlist is what makes the shipped set closed, and that widening the set takes an edit to this manifest. A fail-open `exclude` rule can ship exactly the same paths today, so no listing distinguishes the two and set fidelity alone cannot see the difference. The manifest is therefore read for one question: does it select with an allowlist at all? A literal `[package] include` array of path strings, or `include.workspace = true` resolved to one in `[workspace.package]`, is that allowlist; selection by `exclude` alone, by cargo's defaults, or by an empty or unresolvable `include`, is the finding. An `exclude` carried alongside a present allowlist is inert in cargo and is reported as a note, and the allowlist's contents are not read, because membership is decided by layer (1).

(3) Expectation provenance, the prose against this probe: a transcribed set drifts, and a path token alone says nothing about what the prose claims for it. The guard reads the record clause by clause, splitting a sentence at `:`, `;`, at a comma that opens a new clause, and at a comma that opens a relative clause, so a predicate inside `the models, which ship` qualifies the models and is not read as the sentence's path shipping. A membership predicate is attributed only to a path that the same clause names. In a clause, an inclusion predicate is inclusion and the same predicate behind a negator is exclusion; an exclusion predicate is exclusion and the same predicate behind a negator is inclusion; and the negator is looked for anywhere between the clause's start and the predicate, not within a fixed distance, because a denial can carry intervening words (`is not, under any circumstances whatsoever, carried`) and a negation can precede the path it denies (`no file under `src/` ships`). A member of an enumeration with no predicate of its own inherits the governing predicate from earlier in the sentence; a member that carries its own predicate uses it and lends nothing to its neighbours, so one denied member does not turn the rest of the list into denials. Each path this probe expects must be asserted in that direction by at least one clause and contradicted by none. The expectation is closed in the other direction as well: every backticked path the recorded text names is compared with the transcribed set, and a named path that is neither a shipped path nor one of the three excluded groups is a finding in whichever direction its clause states, quoting that clause, while a backticked expression that is not a path (a setting, a command, a word) is not judged. The exclusion list is therefore decided by structure rather than by a transcription that could go stale: it cannot grow by a clause excluding something unlisted, and it cannot shrink, because a group the probe expects to be excluded would then be named by no clause and reported undecided.

What the guard guarantees: for every path the record names, and every repository file under a group it names, the run compares the listing with the transcribed expectation in both directions and names each absent file by name; for every path this probe expects, the run requires a recorded clause asserting the same direction and reports a recorded clause that contradicts it, quoting that clause; for every path the record names, the run requires it to belong to the recorded set in the direction the set gives it, so a stated exclusion outside the excluded groups is named with its clause; and the selection mechanism is judged for allowlist shape on its own, so a fail-open selection that ships the same paths is still reported. What it does not do: it does not audit prose about paths outside the named set, it does not judge whether the stated reasons are sound, it does not check whether a target the package builds is reachable from the allowlist — a `[[bin]] path` or `build` outside that set is a separate decision — it does not resolve a denial that names no path token, since a pronoun or a bare `The README` is not attributed to the file it refers to, and membership stated in words outside its finite vocabulary is reported as the recorded text not deciding that path rather than being resolved. A path whose membership the record states only through a relative clause is likewise reported as not decided in that sentence. Rewording inside a direction, merged sentences and reordered sentences leave the clause polarity unchanged.

Cargo's pack step adds two bookkeeping files to any archive that the file selection neither adds nor drops; they are outside the set the manifest decides, so the probe names them in its output as a note rather than counting them as authored shipped paths. The run needs no build, no network and no fixture, so a finding is about the set, the mechanism or the prose, never about the harness.
